params.name: Viper 2076
params.note: CONCEPT, generated by scripts/shapes/concepts/viper-2076.mjs (edit that, not this). The Viper fifty years on, after the Bell MV-75 (V-280 Valor) and its Air-Launched Effects: a tiltrotor drone carrier. A slim hull with a wrapped flight-deck windscreen, crew doors and sliding cabin doors; a straight high wing with an engine nacelle fixed at each tip and a three-blade proprotor on a pylon standing on it (helicopter mode; the sim has no tilt); a V-tail; stub wings carrying the old Viper's rocket pods and missiles; the chin gun kept; and four launch tubes each side of the aft fuselage whose eight drones fly out to hold a box round her on the `drones` channel while the master arm is on. The armed heli's 2076 edition (mesh_heli_armed.json `variants`), on its frame: scale 2, the 7-degree sit, the same wheel contacts.

parts.name: fuselage
parts.note: The shell. Glass, frames, doors, launch tubes and trim are separate parts laid a hair proud of it.
